# Kwik 112

> Every Indian already knows how to use it: dial 112. Kwik 112 is the multilingual AI call-taker in that call and the auditable dispatch console behind it — the AI may only escalate severity, and a human makes every dispatch decision.

Kwik 112 is an independent browser-based demonstration. It is not an official 112, ERSS, government, or C-DAC service and has no live emergency-network integration.

## Verified held-out local results

Corpus v1.0.0, held_out split, 30 synthetic calls, provider none: critical recall 100% (9/9; Wilson 95% lower bound 0.70), incident type accuracy 60%, severity accuracy 60%, under-triage 23.3%, over-triage 16.7%, location accuracy 100% (25/25), threat accuracy 100% (3/3), latency p50 ~0.048ms and p95 ~3.79ms.
